title: CLIMATEAGENT: Multi-Agent Orchestration for Complex Climate Data Science Workflows

claim.summary: ClimateAgent coordinates planning, API acquisition and coding with persistent artifacts and recovery, and supplies an 85-task climate-workflow benchmark.

tasks.source_label: Anomaly detection and diagnosis; scientific temporal analysis

modules.name: Shared workflow state and checkpoint serialization
modules.scope_reason: Plans, scripts, files, results and logs persist across subtasks and restarts.
evidence_locators: PDF p.6; method passage beginning Serialization and Persistence.

modules.name: Plan-to-specialist execution orchestration
modules.scope_reason: Ordered subtask delegation and shared execution state are generic workflow mechanisms.
evidence_locators: PDF p.5; method passage beginning The PLAN-AGENT decomposes

modules.name: Climate analysis workflow benchmark
modules.scope_reason: CLIMATE-AGENT-BENCH-85 specifies scientific analysis/report workflows, including named phenomenon detectors, derived indices, visualisations and rubric-based outputs. It is an evaluation task suite, not a reusable cross-task temporal operation; domain diversity alone does not warrant GTS. Keep scientific_temporal_analysis as the explicit task value.
evidence_locators: PDF p.8; method passage beginning CLIMATE-AGENT-BENCH-85 spans
